cases.name: Patricia "Patty" Hope Sturm
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Patty and her family operated the family dairy farm until 2001. Patty then worked at the United States Department of Agriculture in the FSA department. Her interests included sewing, gardening, baking, camping and watching NASCAR racing. Patty was a warm, welcoming person who was always there for everyone. She was a well-liked, outgoing and a personable woman. Patty was a great example of a loving mother and grandmother. Always treasured, were her grandchildren; she was very involved with them and their many activities. Patty was a teddy bear collector and a big John Deere fan. She enjoyed family gatherings and always organized holiday get-togethers. Being a great cook she enjoyed preparing wonderful meals for all to enjoy; delighted to try out new recipes. Patty was very active member of Grace Lutheran Church, teaching Sunday school, singing in the choir and helping to organize the annual Christmas program. She expressed her strong faith, not only in deeds, but by example."
